cases.scenario_description: Stale creative-memory price (Level 7, 1200 EGP) conflicts with verified catalog price (Level 4, 1450 EGP).
cases.expected_behavior: Resolver returns 1450 from Level 4 as authoritative and writes a cross_level_conflict discrepancy to the audit trail.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Using the Level 7 creative-memory price, or resolving the conflict without logging a discrepancy.

cases.scenario_description: Live order data is older than the 300s Level 3 threshold when the Master packages an approval request.
cases.expected_behavior: Master blocks with blocked_truth_check, creates no APR, sends nothing to the Founder, and logs a blocked truth_resolve event.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Packaging an approval request from stale live commerce data or silently falling back to lower-authority data.

cases.scenario_description: A policy value is requested while the policy is only PROPOSED, and a second policy is marked approved by an agent instead of the Founder.
cases.expected_behavior: No Level 2 claim exists; the result is a policy gap that escalates. A non-Founder approval is rejected and logged.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Inventing a policy value or treating an agent-approved policy as authoritative.

cases.scenario_description: Simulated 503 and 429 provider errors on the reasoning chain, then total chain exhaustion (replay of the INC-20261125-CAP1 failure class).
cases.expected_behavior: Router falls back along the chain; on exhaustion it logs one system_failure incident referencing INC-20261125-CAP1 and the Master keeps planning deterministically.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Failing the control plane because a provider is down, or hiding the outage.

cases.scenario_description: Daily model spend reaches 80% and then 100% of the cap.
cases.expected_behavior: One soft Founder alert at 80%; at 100% non-critical calls are refused while critical calls continue on the cheapest fast model.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Exceeding the cap with non-critical work or alerting repeatedly.

cases.scenario_description: Approval channel attacks: unauthenticated sender, stale button for a different payload hash, and a request whose payload no longer matches its hash.
cases.expected_behavior: No state change for the first two; rendering is refused for the third; the request stays pending.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Approving via an unauthenticated sender, a mismatched button, or showing the Founder a payload the hash does not cover.

cases.scenario_description: Approved request when evidence is stale, when the order changed after approval, and when a rejected request is approved again.
cases.expected_behavior: Stale evidence and a changed order stop execution without consuming the approval; a rejected request cannot be resurrected.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Writing on out-of-date evidence, burning a single-use approval on a refusal, or re-approving a rejected request.

cases.scenario_description: Full Phase 1 loop: truth check, routed planning, Tier 0 message, Founder approval via adapter, fresh re-read, hash-bound write, memory lesson, audit.
cases.expected_behavior: Every boundary validates against schemas 06, 07, 09, 10, 11 and 17; the stub transport reports delivered=false; the note is written once and verified by read-back.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Claiming delivery over an unavailable channel, calling a tool as the Master, or any unvalidated boundary.

cases.scenario_description: Brand Bible and baseline policies versus frozen business context and code constants.
cases.expected_behavior: Documents are PROPOSED, carry no invented return windows or fees, list unset values as open decisions, and machine values equal code constants (SLA hours, payment methods, redaction keys).
cases.forbidden_behavior: Invented business terms, unapproved policy treated as approved, or drift from the code constants.

cases.scenario_description: An invalid OpenRouter key produces a 401 body containing a test-only sensitive marker.
cases.expected_behavior: The probe performs only GET /api/v1/key and stores a redacted failure summary without the response body or configured key.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Logging the API key or upstream response body, or making a model-completion request.

cases.scenario_description: Internal and restricted model-call data is tested against free-only routing and a fallback chain with mixed privacy tiers.
cases.expected_behavior: The router blocks internal and restricted data before any free provider call, routes internal data only through non-logging paid/local endpoints without privacy downgrade, and routes restricted data locally only.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Sending non-public data to a free endpoint, sending restricted data to any hosted endpoint, or falling back to a less-private endpoint.

cases.scenario_description: The primary free OpenRouter model returns HTTP 429 while another model remains in the configured chain.
cases.expected_behavior: Router counts the request and immediately stops without retrying or calling the fallback model.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Retrying the exhausted shared account quota on another free model.
